pairing.title: Connect this kiosk
pairing.prompt: Enter the eight-digit pairing code from the admin panel
pairing.scanHint: The scanner is already on — you can scan the code at any time
pairing.scanWaitingHint: Point the scanner at the barcode in the admin panel
pairing.scanRejected: Not a pairing code: eight digits are required
pairing.binding: Binding the device… downloading settings and operators
pairing.invalidCode: The code is wrong, expired, or there have been too many attempts. Get a new code from the admin panel.
pairing.connectionFailed: No connection to the server. Check the network and try again.
pairing.badBundle: The server sent unusable data. Ask the administrator for a new code.
pairing.codeSpent: The code has already been used, but the kiosk could not save the data. Ask the administrator for a new code.
pairing.boundNoPlace: Kiosk bound — no point is set
pairing.boundHint: Wrong kiosk? Unbind it in the admin panel and pair the right one.

idle.title: Scan your badge
idle.subtitle: Hold your badge up to the scanner. You can scan products after signing in.
idle.hint: The QR code is on the back of your badge. Hold it up to the scanner below the screen, then scan the marking codes on the bottles.
idle.badgeUnknown: Badge not recognised. Scan it again, or ask an administrator.
idle.notABadge: Scan your badge first — you can scan the bottles right after that.
idle.settingsHold: Keep holding — the settings sign-in will open

cart.scanHint: The code is on the label, next to the Chestny ZNAK mark
cart.limitHint: Take something off the list, or press Done
cart.emptyHint: Scan your first bottle — it will appear here
cart.submit: Done — hand over to the administrator
cart.duplicate: This code is already on the list. Every bottle has its own code: take another one.
cart.incomplete: The code was read only partly — the scanner dropped the separator. Scan this bottle again.
cart.notACode: That is a plain barcode, not a marking code. Scan the square code next to the Chestny ZNAK mark.
cart.unknownTitle: This bottle cannot be taken here
cart.unknownBody: This kiosk does not issue it. Put the bottle aside and ask an administrator — you can carry on scanning the others.

done.title: Order {{order}} handed over
done.titleQueued: Order handed over — its number appears once the kiosk syncs
done.subtitle: Tell the administrator — they will file the order
done.subtitleTail: and take the codes out of circulation.
done.queuedCheck: The server still has to check the order — some bottles may not make it in.
done.refusedHint: Not one code went through. Put the bottles aside and ask an administrator.
done.autoReset: The screen returns to the start in {{seconds}} seconds
done.conflictsHint: Put those bottles aside and show them to an administrator — they did not make it into the order.

conflictReason.incomplete: the code was read only partly
conflictReason.unknown_product: the product is not in the catalogue
conflictReason.not_allowed: this kiosk does not issue it
conflictReason.duplicate: duplicate — the code is already in another order
conflictReason.other: the code was not accepted — ask the administrator why

blocked.title: This kiosk is not issuing products right now
blocked.body: Its data is out of date: it has not reached the server for over a week. Ask an administrator — the kiosk needs the internet.
blocked.queue: Orders already taken are not lost — {{n}} in the queue. They will reach the server on their own as soon as the connection is back.
blocked.queueEmpty: Every order already taken has reached the server — nothing is lost.

status.offline: No connection — the kiosk is working offline
status.stale: The data was last refreshed more than a day ago
status.staleHours: The data was last refreshed {{n}} hours ago
status.staleDays: The data was last refreshed {{n}} days ago
status.quarantined: Orders the server refused: {{n}} — an administrator is needed

scannerSetup.title: Scanner setup
scannerSetup.transportKeyboardHint: Works on any device: the scanner types the code as if it were a keyboard.
scannerSetup.transportSerialHint: More reliable: the GS separator inside a marking code survives.
scannerSetup.serialNotGranted: No port was chosen, so the kiosk stayed in keyboard mode. Tap Web Serial again and pick the scanner's COM port in the browser dialog.
scannerSetup.transportSerialUnavailable: Web Serial is not available on this device, so only the keyboard mode is offered.
scannerSetup.testPrompt: Scan any code — the kiosk will show what it recognised.
scannerSetup.resultIncomplete: A marking code without the GS separator — the scanner dropped it. Switch to Web Serial.
scannerSetup.resultIncompleteNoSerial: A marking code without the GS separator — the scanner dropped it. Web Serial is not available on this device, so turn on GS separator output (FNC1) in the scanner's own settings.
scannerSetup.gatePrompt: Scan your badge, or enter your personnel number and PIN.
scannerSetup.gateError: Could not sign in. Check the personnel number and the PIN.
scannerSetup.gateRecovery: Can't sign in? Unbind this kiosk in the admin panel and pair it again with a new code — until it is paired, scanner setup opens without a sign-in.
